pages.text: $(thing)Click$() a pipe face to cycle it between connected, disconnected and extract.$(br2)$(thing)Sneak and click$() an extract face to copy its settings. The next extract face you create with that wrench starts from the copy.$(br2)$(thing)Sneak and click$() any other face to dismantle the pipe. Its settings and upgrade are kept in the dropped item.
Any item in the $(thing)c:tools/wrench$() tag behaves the same way.$(br2)An empty hand while sneaking reports the size and weakest tier of the connected line.
